## 1.3 R Script (`govtdata01.R`) – Downloading Documents

1.  Load R packages for web requests and file downloads (for example, `httr`, `jsonlite`, `tidyverse`).
2.  Craft search queries or use GovInfo’s API to pull results that match Foreign Relations Committee.
    -   GovInfo has a Search API that accepts POST requests. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index="3"}
3.  Download documents using returned URLs.
4.  Save each downloaded file locally (e.g., as PDF, XML, or text).

# Define search query

search_url \<- "https://api.govinfo.gov/search" query_body \<- list( query = "Committee on Foreign Relations", pageSize = 10, offsetMark = "\*" )

API key

api_key \<- Sys.getenv("GOVINFO_API_KEY")

response \<- POST( search_url, add_headers(`X-Api-Key` = api_key), body = query_body, encode = "json" )

search_results \<- content(response, as = "parsed", simplifyVector = TRUE)

Access result items

docs \<- search_results\$results

Loop to download each document (if a direct document link is available)

for (i in seq_along(docs)) { doc \<- docs\[\[i\]\] download_link \<- doc\$link \# Replace with actual document URL element download_file \<- paste0("doc\_", i, ".pdf") GET(download_link, write_disk(download_file)) }
